summary: Full regression + new-feature verification for IT Module (A) assign-on-create with active-only picker + backend re-validation, and (B) HRMS re-skin. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_it_asset_assign_on_create.py with 10 targeted tests -> 10/10 PASS. Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_it_components_phase1.py -> 10/10 PASS. Verified: (1) POST /api/it/assets with assign_employee_id=ACTIVE emp returns status='Assigned', assigned_to set, asset assignment_history has open period for that employee; (2) without assign_employee_id, asset is created with status='In Stock' and assigned_to=null; (3) with INACTIVE emp: 400 'Selected employee is no longer active.'; (4) with bogus emp id: 400 'not found'; (5) post-create /it/assets/{id}/assign flow still works and sets assignment; (6) GET /api/employees?status=Active returns only Active employees (source for the picker); (7) RBAC: employee token 'user'/'pass123' gets 403 on POST /it/assets and GET /it/assets; /api/employee/it-assets and /api/employee/it-components remain 200 for employee. Frontend (playwright @1920x1080 and 390x844): IT module loads, no full-page horizontal overflow at either viewport, tabs render, Add Asset dialog opens with it-form-category and the new it-active-emp-search present, typing 'a' surfaced 20 active-employee options (it-active-emp-opt-*), selecting one rendered the it-active-emp-selected chip. Assets tab controls verified: it-asset-search, it-filter-category, it-filter-status, it-page-size, it-export-btn, it-tab-components, it-tab-import, it-add-asset-btn, it-asset-row-*, it-view-*, it-history. Components tab: comp-add-btn present. Design re-skin looks consistent (Outfit headings, #063c88 primary, surface #fffdf7).

design_issues.screen: Asset detail dialog & Add Asset dialog
issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle/aria-describedby — console emits accessibility warnings/errors. Non-functional but should be fixed for a11y.

action_items: (Optional / a11y) Wrap Asset detail Radix DialogContent with a DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if not visually needed) and add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to eliminate the Radix console error/warning. Same for the Add Asset dialog description warning.
critical_code_review_comments: _emp_snapshot_active correctly gates on employee_status=='Active' and reuses _emp_snapshot for the payload shape — good separation.

it_create_asset assign-on-create branch re-invokes the same primitives (open_asset_assignment + sync_components_on_asset_reassign) so assignment history and component inheritance are automatically consistent with the existing 'assign later' flow. No duplication of logic.
Backend re-validates active status at POST /it/assets time so even a stale frontend cache cannot bypass the check — verified by test_create_asset_inactive_employee_rejected.
server.py is huge (~4780+ LOC around the employees endpoint). Consider splitting employee/HR routers similar to it_asset/router.py for maintainability. Not a functional issue.
Add Asset & Asset Detail Radix Dialogs are missing DialogTitle/DialogDescription — accessibility gap (Radix warning). Low-risk but should be addressed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested surface (Add Asset + active picker + filters + tabs + detail dialog + responsive @ 1920 & 390)
